ownership: Dedicated task directory created for this campaign. Pickles matched all existing canonical receipts; executable bytes matched archived source; remaining files are task logs, dispatch JSON, bytecode or the monitor sentinel.
reference_policy: Temporary paths in inference/source receipts remain immutable historical provenance. Final models, consolidated predictions, label datasets, canonical evaluations, provider and shared-cache research reference are outside this directory and retained.
recovery: Inventory is persisted before deletion. Recreate exact common.py and cleanup_temporary.py from adapter source_text if interrupted, run with python -B, and resume this inventory without replacing it. After the directory is absent, use the official harness CLI and the persistent cleanup audit to close; do not recreate event files in the deleted directory.
